title: Guarding the Tongue
subtitle: A concise collection of practical notes, ideas, and reminders on the importance of controlling speech in Islam.

notes.title: The power of a small part
notes.paragraph: The tongue is a small part of the body, but through it a person can teach, encourage, and make peace—or cause serious harm through lying, backbiting, and hurtful words[cite: 12].

notes.title: Speak good or remain silent
notes.paragraph: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent, choosing safety from unnecessary and harmful speech[cite: 14].

notes.title: Wounds of words
notes.paragraph: An Arabic wisdom saying reminds us that the wound caused by words can be more severe than the wound caused by arrows, leaving lasting memories in people[cite: 15].

notes.title: Guard your daily speech
notes.paragraph: Before speaking, ask whether it is true, beneficial, and respectful, protecting others and keeping family and community relationships strong[cite: 12, 16].
